items.summary: arXiv:2610.10786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. items.summary: arXiv:2610.11012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Powerful misaligned AI models might recognize alignment evaluations and strategically behave well on them, rendering direct audits uninformative. items.summary: arXiv:2610.11050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computer-use agents are capable of completing complex tasks, increasing the use of automatic judges to determine success, either for training or for evaluation without human involvement. items.title: Beyond Imitation: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Peer Review
items.summary: arXiv:2610.11087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of scientific publishing has strained peer review, particularly in machine learning, raising concerns about declining review quality and increasing reviewer workload. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as automated review assistants, yet their evaluation has focused largely on imitating human-written reviews rather than supporting the core functions of peer review. Here, we introduce a verification-centric perspective on LLM-assisted peer review, emphasizing error detection as a critical and resource-intensive task.

items.summary: arXiv:2610.11129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. items.summary: arXiv:2610.11155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) is prevalent among adolescents with depression, but the rapid brain-state dynamics linking social distress to maladaptive behavior remain unclear. items.summary: We present a network model that enables a navigating agent to shape the spatial and temporal structure of its paths through its environment. The model is inspired by the insect fan-shaped body. In it, a recurrent neural network receives an input that encodes an agent's velocity vector. Meanwhile, network activity determines the setpoint of a control loop that influences this velocity vector through motor outputs. The network thus guides future movement using memory of past movement. We illustrate how the network's dynamics determine the trajectory features it extracts to produce the setpoint.

items.summary: Recurrent connections are pervasive in visual cortex, and visual representations evolve as recurrent processing unfolds. items.summary: Spontaneous spinal cord regeneration is an endogenous process operational in diverse vertebrate and select mammalian species. items.title: ВОЙНА В УКРАИНЕ ПЕРЕСТРАИВАЕТ МИР / ПУТИН ТЕРЯЕТ ЯДЕРНЫЙ БЛЕФ /№1218/ Юрий Швец
items.summary: Загадочная смерть сотрудницы Иркутского противочумного института превращается в международный вопрос биобезопасности. США и ВОЗ требуют от Москвы назвать патоген. Российские власти утверждают, что чума не выявлена, но одновременно признают наличие инфекции, которую пока не готовы идентифицировать. Особое значение приобретает свидетельство бывшего высокопоставленного участника советской программы биологического оружия Кена Алибека. Бывший американский чиновник Маршалл Биллингсли, лично работавший с ним после его переезда в США, напоминает: Алибек рассказывал об антибиотикоустойчивых штаммах чум
